capabilities: Chat with OpenAI-compatible models in a sidebar
Create, edit, rename and delete notes from chat
Search the vault with ranked, token-free results
Fetch web pages and download files into the vault
Compress, resize and analyze attached images
disambiguation: Not a multi-user or real-time collaboration chat; it is a single-user AI chat sidebar.
extras: Full documentation is on the plugin wiki. API keys are kept in Obsidian SecretStorage, which is not synced, so keys must be added on each device. File changes prompt for confirmation unless YOLO mode is enabled.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hold a conversation with an LLM that can also act on your notes and vault content.

relations.evidence: OpenRouter (live model list, per-model pricing, favourites)
add a Brave or Tavily key for better search

summary: Chat sidebar for any OpenAI-compatible API that can read and edit notes, search the vault, browse the web and process images.
